title: Keystone replay-equality test (AC-E10) runs in a no-pipes topology, so it never exercises delivery/routing determinism across runs
detail: RunState.bootstrap places the 6-node MVP map with NO pipes; stepping [] never draws any. All era-3 demand drops 'unreachable', so AC-E10 verifies spawn/drop determinism but never delivery or routing determinism across same-seed runs.
recommended_fix: Add a wired-run replay test: bootstrap, apply a DrawPipe batch, step N ticks twice from the same seed, assert byte-identical fingerprints — exercising delivery + routing determinism, not just spawn/drop.
